title: Biogenic silver NPs alleviate LPS-induced neuroinflammation in a human fetal brain-derived cell line: Molecular switch to the M2 phenotype, modulation of TLR4/MyD88 and Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathways, and molecular docking analysis.
authors: Sharma, Anshul; Sanjay; Jaiswal, Varun; Park, Miey; Lee, Hae-Jeung
one_liner_zh: 该文研究生物合成银纳米颗粒对LPS诱导神经炎症的缓解作用及TLR4/Nrf2信号通路，分子对接仅针对植物成分与蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) have inconsistent findings against inflammation. Although a wealth of literature on the beneficial effects of green-synthesized AgNPs has been published, a detailed mechanistic study of green AgNPs on the protective effects against lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced neuroinflammation using human microglial cells (HMC3) has not yet been reported. For the first time, we studied the inhibitory effect of biogenic AgNPs on inflammation and oxidative stress induced by LPS in HMC3 cells. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, and transmission electron microscopy were used to characterize AgNPs produced from honeyberry. Co-treatment with AgNPs significantly reduced mRNA expressions of inflammatory molecules such as interleukin (IL)-6 and tumor necrosis factor-alpha, while increasing the expressions of anti-inflammatory markers such as IL-10 and transforming growth factor (TGF)-beta. HMC3 cells were also switched from M1 to M2, as shown by lower expression of M1 markers such as cluster of differentiation (CD)80, CD86, and CD68 and higher expression of M2 markers such as CD206, CD163, and triggering receptors expressed on myeloid cells (TREM2). Furthermore, AgNPs inhibited LPS-induced toll-like receptor (TLR)4 signaling, as evidenced by decreased expression of myeloid differentiation factor 88 (MyD88) and TLR4. In addition, AgNPs reduced the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and enhanced the expression of nuclear factor-E2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), while decreasing the expression of inducible nitric oxide synthase. The docking score of the honeyberry phytoconstituents ranged from -14.93 to - 4.28 KJ/mol. In conclusion, biogenic AgNPs protect against neuroinflammation and oxidative stress by targeting TLR4/MyD88 and Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathways in a LPS-induced in vitro model. Biogenic AgNPs could be utilized as potential nanomedicine against LPS-induced inflammatory disorders.
abstract_zh: 银纳米颗粒（AgNPs）在炎症方面的研究结果不一致。尽管已有大量关于绿色合成AgNPs有益作用的文献发表，但关于绿色AgNPs在人小胶质细胞（HMC3）中对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的神经炎症提供保护作用的详细机制研究尚未见报道。我们首次研究了生物源性AgNPs对LPS诱导的HMC3细胞炎症和氧化应激的抑制作用。采用X射线光电子能谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱和透射电子显微镜对从蜂蜜莓中制备的AgNPs进行了表征。与AgNPs共处理显著降低了炎症分子如白细胞介素（IL）-6和肿瘤坏死因子-α的mRNA表达，同时增加了抗炎标志物如IL-10和转化生长因子（TGF）-β的表达。HMC3细胞也从M1型转变为M2型，表现为M1标志物如分化簇（CD）80、CD86和CD68的表达降低，以及M2标志物如CD206、CD163和髓系细胞触发受体（TREM2）的表达升高。此外，AgNPs抑制了LPS诱导的Toll样受体（TLR）4信号通路，这通过髓样分化因子88（MyD88）和TLR4表达降低得以证实。另外，AgNPs减少了活性氧（ROS）的产生，并增强了核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）和血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）的表达，同时降低了诱导型一氧化氮合酶的表达。蜂蜜莓植物成分的对接得分范围为-14.93至-4.28 kJ/mol。总之，生物源性AgNPs通过靶向TLR4/MyD88和Nrf2/HO-1信号通路，在LPS诱导的体外模型中对抗神经炎症和氧化应激。生物源性AgNPs可作为潜在的纳米药物，用于对抗LPS诱导的炎症性疾病。
